notes:
Lead type: inbound SMB (self-serve). Primary contact: CTO (Maya Rao) -- hands-on with evaluation. Wants Hosted API to avoid infra. Key ask: which model family to pick for customer-facing chat + product recommendations given tight monthly budget.

Customer details and requirements (copied from call):
- Traffic: seasonal spikes; baseline ~50 QPS across multiple endpoints, peak ~400 QPS for flash sales (expects to use autoscaling on hosted tier).
- Latency goal: p95 < 350ms for chat simple Qs; can accept up to 800ms for long-form retrieval-augmented answers.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Wants to understand quality delta between Mistral/Mistral-instruct variants, Llama 2 13B, and Qwen 7B / 14B; wants per-token cost projections for 100M tokens/month.
- Model preferences: open to open-weight models, no need for proprietary closed models. Interested in cheaper quantized variants if quality holds.
- Routing/fallback: wants simple cost-based fallback (cheap variant when latency not critical), and single-API surface if possible.
- Security: SOC2 is required; SSO currently optional but planned; needs audit logs and retention policy for 90 days.

Direct quote from CTO: "If we can get ~95% of the quality at half the price, we can run this in prod next quarter."

Questions asked during discovery (paraphrased):
- "How does Llama-2-13B compare to Mistral-7B-instruct in few-shot for product recommendation prompts?"
- "Can you provide a cost/latency estimate for Qwen-7B vs Qwen-14B streaming responses?"
- "What are options to do prefix caching for repeated product descriptions? Any built-in caching on Hosted API?"

Sales notes / recommended next steps:
- SE to share an A/B-style prompt eval summary across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B-Instruct, Qwen-7B (quantized), with tokenized per-response cost calculations for target throughput. Include latency benchmarks (p50/p95) for hosted tier typical config.
- Provide a short guide on using routing policies to fallback to cheaper variants and enable automatic prefix caching to reduce token costs.

- Offer a 14-day credit extension to run guided perf/cost tests if they commit to a minimal trial plan.
